title: Decide whether to split preflop spots by raiser position and re-raise type
description: Follow-up from TASK-7.2 Q-4. REQ-032.2 fixes 26 spots, so blind defence and facing-a-raise ignore who raised (BB defends the same vs UTG as vs a BTN steal), and facing-a-re-raise lumps 'my open was 3-bet' with 'cold 3-bet'. A real strategy weakness the user chose to ship and revisit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given options (split by raiser position, split re-raise by open-vs-cold, keep 26 spots), When the user decides, Then the decision is recorded as a Backlog decision and REQ-032.2 and the chart format are updated if needed

Given re-raise spots are split into 'my open was 3-bet' and 'cold 3-bet', When the CO cold-3-bet spot is authored, Then CO A9o/A8o are reconsidered (TASK-7.19 folds them only because TASK-9.1's locked review test pins CO A9o as Fold) and that test is updated if the advice changes

implementationNotes:
Evidence from TASK-7.19 (user Q-1/Q-3, 2026-11-19): re-raise spots now continue with 80-90% of each opener's range, which suits 'my open was 3-bet' but makes cold 3-bet routes loose. For example, CO facing a UTG open and an HJ 3-bet continues ~22% of hands from an uninvested seat. Splitting the spot would fix this.

AC added from TASK-7.19 follow-up (doc-28).
